User Memories.query: Show me my memories about Python.
User Memories.sql:
SELECT "User Memories".memory, "User Memories".category, "User Memories".emotional_salience, "User Memories".created_at 
FROM "User Memories" 
WHERE "User Memories".memory ILIKE '%%Python%%' OR "User Memories".category ILIKE '%%Python%%'

User Memories.query: Find my high importance memories about Python.
User Memories.sql:
SELECT "User Memories".memory, "User Memories".category, "User Memories".emotional_salience, "User Memories".created_at 
FROM "User Memories" 
WHERE ("User Memories".memory ILIKE '%%high%%' OR "User Memories".category ILIKE '%%high%%') AND ("User Memories".memory ILIKE '%%Python%%' OR "User Memories".category ILIKE '%%Python%%')

User Memories.query: Find memories about Python or machine learning.

SELECT "User Memories".memory, "User Memories".category, "User Memories".emotional_salience, "User Memories".created_at

WHERE "User Memories".memory ILIKE '%%Python%%' OR "User Memories".category ILIKE '%%Python%%' OR "User Memories".memory ILIKE '%%machine learning%%' OR "User Memories".category ILIKE '%%machine learning%%'

User Memories.query: Find my personal biography memories that aren't about professional milestones, captured before 2025.
User Memories.sql:
SELECT "User Memories".memory, "User Memories".category, "User Memories".emotional_salience, "User Memories".created_at 
FROM "User Memories" 
WHERE ("User Memories".memory ILIKE '%%personal_bio%%' OR "User Memories".category ILIKE '%%personal_bio%%') AND NOT ("User Memories".memory ILIKE '%%professional_milestone%%' OR "User Memories".category ILIKE '%%professional_milestone%%') AND "User Memories".created_at = '< 2025-01-01T00:00:00'

User Memories.query: Show me high importance memories about career achievements or programming that aren't related to hobbies, from before 2025.

payload.logic_expression: v1 AND (v2 OR v3) AND NOT v4

User Memories.sql:
SELECT "User Memories".memory, "User Memories".category, "User Memories".emotional_salience, "User Memories".created_at 
FROM "User Memories" 
WHERE ("User Memories".memory ILIKE '%%high%%' OR "User Memories".category ILIKE '%%high%%') AND ("User Memories".memory ILIKE '%%career achievements professional milestone%%' OR "User Memories".category ILIKE '%%career achievements professional milestone%%' OR "User Memories".memory ILIKE '%%programming coding software development%%' OR "User Memories".category ILIKE '%%programming coding software development%%') AND NOT ("User Memories".memory ILIKE '%%hobbies leisure recreational activities%%' OR "User Memories".category ILIKE '%%hobbies leisure recreational activities%%') AND "User Memories".created_at = '< 2025-01-01T00:00:00'

Team Projects.query: Find all projects about mobile app.

search_variables.search_signal: mobile app development, iOS, Android, mobile application

Team Projects.sql:
SELECT "Team Projects".project_report, "Team Projects".status, "Team Projects".priority, "Team Projects".owner_team, "Team Projects".lead_user_id, "Team Projects".target_quarter 
FROM "Team Projects" 
WHERE "Team Projects".project_report ILIKE '%%mobile app development, iOS, Android, mobile application%%' OR "Team Projects".owner_team ILIKE '%%mobile app development, iOS, Android, mobile application%%' OR "Team Projects".lead_user_id ILIKE '%%mobile app development, iOS, Android, mobile application%%' OR "Team Projects".target_quarter ILIKE '%%mobile app development, iOS, Android, mobile application%%'
